correctness.rationale: Exhaustive 1920-element even-signed permutation enumeration and absolute-order membership give 182 noncrossing elements. All chains and order-preserving conjugation orbits are reconstructed, with rank-preserving action preventing simplex inversions. The signed quotient boundary matrices compose to zero, with exact integer Smith diagonal factors (1^31), (1^196,2), (1^250,2). Chain ranks and coker short exact sequences prove H0=Z, H1=Z/2, H2=Z/2 and H3=Z^5. Published EL-shellability gives simply connected cover, and stabilizer-generated C4 in C8 yields pi1=C2 by Armstrong. The standalone code is executed successfully with independently predicted maximal-chain count and mod-two dimensions. No all-rank assertion is made.

originality.rationale: The inspected original descriptions and shellability/chain/CSP results give lattice enumeration, cover homotopy and fixed-element counts. Later Milnor-fiber calculations concern distinct spaces. The torsion class in H2 of the actual nonfree Coxeter quotient comes from the computed Smith factor of its ∂3 matrix; it is not determined by these enumerative inputs or the homology of the covering complex. Targeted published-literature, exact-parameter and database searches identified no equivalent computation; priority remains conditional on indexed and inspected evidence.

value.rationale: The type-D5 Coxeter action is a canonical nonfree symmetry on a classic shellable lattice and has stabilizers of two distinct nontrivial orders. Passing to its geometric quotient changes torsion-free cover homology into two consecutive integral two-torsion groups, a substantive topological distinction invisible in fixed-point counts and rational Betti numbers. The complete finite calculation supplies a natural benchmark at the first odd D rank and does not rely on an arbitrary parameter slice or unsupported downstream claims.
